questions.question: The average weight of eight persons is 40 kg. If one person is removed, then the average weight becomes 38 kg. The weight of the removed person is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of 8 persons = 40 kg

Average weight of 7 persons = 38 kg

**Concept:**

Average weight = (Total weight/Number of persons)

**Solution:**

Total weight of 8 persons = Average weight × Number of persons

⇒ 40 kg × 8 = 320 kg

Total weight of 7 persons = Average weight × Number of persons

⇒ 38 kg × 7 = 266 kg

Weight of the removed person = Total weight of 8 persons - Total weight of 7 persons

⇒ 320 kg - 266 kg = 54 kg

**Therefore, the weight of the removed person is 54 kg.**

questions.question: The cost price of an article is 64% of the marked price. Calculate the gain percentage after allowing a discount of 20%.
questions.solution:
Given:

Cost Price (CP) = 64% of Marked Price (MP)

Discount = 20% of MP

**Concept:**

Gain% = ((Selling Price (SP) - CP)/CP) × 100%

**Solution:**

SP after 20% discount = MP - (20% of MP) ⇒ 0.80 × MP

CP = 0.64 × MP, so Gain% = ((SP - CP)/CP) × 100% ⇒ ((0.80 MP - 0.64 MP)/0.64 MP) × 100% = 25%

**Therefore, the gain percentage is 0.25 or 25%.**

questions.question: Atul alone can complete a work in 114 days. How many persons were required with the same efficiency as Atul to complete the same work in 19 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

Atul's time to complete the work = 114 days

Required time to complete the work = 19 days

**Concept:**

If each person works at the same speed, then the number of people required is inversely proportional to the time taken.

**Solution:**

Number of persons required = Atul's time/Required time ⇒ 114/19 = 6

**Therefore, 6 persons are required to complete the work in 19 days.**

questions.question: There is a cone with diameter 14 cm and height 12 cm. It is being filled with water at a rate of 4 cm³ in every 10 s. How long will it take to fill the cone? (Use pi = {22over 7})
questions.solution:
Given:

Diameter of the cone = 14 cm

Height of the cone = 12 cm

Rate of filling = 4 cm³ every 10 s

**Concept:**

Volume of a cone = 1/3 × π × r² × h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

**Solution:**

Volume of the cone = 1/3 × (22/7) × (14/2)² × 12 cm³ = 616 cm³

Time to fill the cone = Volume of cone/Rate of filling ⇒ 616 cm³/(4 cm³/10s) = 1540 s

**Therefore, it will take 1540 seconds to fill the cone.**

questions.question: The fourth proportional to 2 hours 40 minutes, 1 hours 20 minutes and 10 hours is:
questions.solution:
Given:

First proportion = 2 hours 40 minutes = 160 minutes

Second proportion = 1 hour 20 minutes = 80 minutes

Third proportion = 10 hours = 600 minutes

**Concept:** In the fourth proportional, if a ∶ b = c ∶ d, then d = (b × c)/a.

**Solution:**

Fourth proportional (in minutes) = (Second proportion × Third proportion)/First proportion ⇒ (80 × 600)/160 = 300 minutes = 5 hours

**Therefore, the fourth proportional is 5 hours.**

questions.question: The average weight of 34 persons is increased by 3 kg when one person weighing 90 kg is replaced by a new person. Weight of the new person is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Average weight of 34 persons increased by 3 kg

Weight of person replaced = 90 kg

**Concept:**

Total weight = Average weight × Number of persons

**Solution:**

Increase in total weight = Increase in average weight × Number of persons ⇒ 3 kg × 34 = 102 kg

Weight of the new person = Weight of person replaced + Increase in total weight

⇒ 90 kg + 102 kg = 192 kg

**Therefore, the weight of the new person is 192 kg.**

questions.question: Find the difference between the digits of the greatest number that can exactly divide 144 and 216?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two numbers: 144 and 216

**Concept:**

We need to find the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) and then the difference between its digits.

**Solution:**

GCD of 144 and 216 = 72

Difference between the digits of 72 = |7 - 2| = 5

**Therefore, the difference between the digits of the greatest number that can exactly divide 144 and 216 is 5.**

questions.question: Two persons P and Q working together can do a piece of work in 36 days. Q alone can do it in 45 days. Q alone start the work and left the work after 5 days. How many days will P take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
Given:

P + Q's time = 36 days

Q's time = 45 days

Q worked alone for 5 days

**Concept:**

Work done is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work.

**Solution:**

P's time = (P + Q's time) × (Q's time)/(Q's time - P + Q's time) ⇒ 36 × 45/(45 - 36) = 180 days

Work done by Q in 5 days = 5/Q's time ⇒ 5/45 of the total work

Remaining work = 1 - 5/45 = 40/45 of the total work

Time for P to complete the remaining work = Remaining work × P's time ⇒ (40/45) × 180 = 160 days

**Therefore, P will take 160 days to complete the remaining work.**

questions.question: If the third proportion to 3 and 27 is ‘x‘, then what would be the HCF of ‘x‘ and 27?
questions.solution:
Given:

First number = 3

Second number = 27

**Concept:**

In third proportional if a ∶ b = b ∶ c, then c = b²/a. The highest common factor (HCF) is the greatest number that divides both numbers.

**Solution:**

Third proportional 'x' = 27²/3 = 243

HCF of 'x' and 27 = HCF(243, 27) = 27

**Therefore, the HCF of 'x' and 27 is 27.**

questions.question: If 5 over 8 of 184 × 15 ÷ 5 + k = 513 ÷ 9 + 435, then the value of k is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Equation: 5 over 8 of 184 × 15 ÷ 5 + k = 513 ÷ 9 + 435

**Concept:**

Use basic arithmetic operations to solve for 'k'.

**Solution:**

Simplifying both sides, we have: (5/8) × 184 × (15/5) + k = (513/9) + 435

Solving further, 345 + k = 57 + 435

⇒ k = 57 + 435 - 345 = 147

**Therefore, the value of k is 147.**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the voters cast their votes out of which 5% of votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 285000 votes which was 75% of the total valid votes. The total number of voters enrolled for that election was:
questions.solution:
Given:

Percentage of voters who cast their votes = 80%

Percentage of invalid votes = 5%

Candidate's votes = 285,000 (which is 75% of total valid votes)

**Concept:**

Simple percentage calculations.

**Solution:**

Total valid votes = Candidate's votes/0.75 = 380,000 votes

Total votes cast = Total valid votes/(1 - 0.05) = 400,000 votes

Total voters enrolled = Total votes cast/0.80 = 500,000 voters

**Therefore, the total number of voters enrolled for that election was 500,000.**

questions.question: Shlok drives the first 140 km in 3 hrs and the next 180 km in 5 hrs. What is his average speed (in km/h) for the entire trip?
questions.solution:
Given:

Distance covered in first trip = 140 km

Time taken for first trip = 3 hours

Distance covered in second trip = 180 km

Time taken for second trip = 5 hours

**Concept:**

Average speed = Total distance/Total time.

**Solution:**

Total distance = 140 km + 180 km = 320 km

Total time = 3 hours + 5 hours = 8 hours

Average speed = 320 km/8 hours = 40 km/h

**Therefore, the average speed for the entire trip is 40 km/h.**

questions.question: The selling price of a product is such that the seller earns a profit of 20% on the cost price. Determine the ratio of selling price to cost price.
questions.solution:
Given:

Profit percentage = 20%

**Concept:**

If there is a profit of x%, the ratio of selling price to cost price is (100 + x) ∶ 100.

**Solution:**

The ratio of selling price to cost price = (100 + 20) ∶ 100 = 120 ∶ 100 = 6 ∶ 5

**Therefore, the ratio of the selling price to the cost price is 6 over 5.**

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 1600 but Rohan gets a discount of 20 percent. He sells the article for Rs. 1600. Rohan‘s gain percent is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Marked price = Rs. 1600

Discount percent = 20%

Selling price = Rs. 1600

**Concept:**

Gain percentage can be calculated as (Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price × 100%.

**Solution:**

Cost price for Rohan = Marked price - Discount = Rs. 1600 - 0.2 × Rs. 1600 = Rs. 1280

Gain percent = (Rs. 1600 - Rs. 1280)/Rs. 1280 × 100% = 25%

**Therefore, Rohan's gain percent is 25%.**

questions.question: A fruit merchant makes a profit of 25% by selling mangoes at a certain price. If he charges Rs. 3 more on each mango, he will gain 40%. Find the cost price of one mango
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in profit percentages = 40% − 25% = 15%

This 15% of CP corresponds to the increase in selling price, which is Rs. 3.

⇒ 15% of CP = 3

⇒ 1% of CP = 3 ÷ 15 = 0.2

⇒ 100% of CP = 0.2 × 100 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Profit in case 1 = 25%

Profit in case 2 = 40%

Difference in Selling Prices (SP₂ − SP₁) = Rs. 3

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

According to the question,

questions.question: A boat is moving in still water at a speed of 15 km/h. The speed of the stream is 3 km/h. How much time will the boat take to cover 6 km upstream?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Upstream Speed = Speed of Boat − Speed of Stream = 15 − 3 = 12 km/h.

Time = Distance ÷ Upstream Speed = 6 ÷ 12 = 0.5 hours.

0.5 hours = 0.5 × 60 = 30 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 minutes.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in still water (u) = 15 km/h

Speed of stream (v) = 3 km/h

Distance (d) = 6 km

**Formula Used:**

Upstream Speed (Sᵤₚ) = Speed of boat (u) − Speed of stream (v)

Time (T) = Distance (d) ÷ Speed (S)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken = 6 ÷ 12 hours

⇒ Time = 0.5 hours

⇒ Time in minutes = 0.5 × 60

⇒ Time = 30 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 30 minutes.**

**__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When the boat moves with the flow of the stream, its speed is Sdₒwₙ = u + v.

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If downstream speed (D) and upstream speed (U) are known, speed in still water u = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of the Stream

The speed of the current or stream v = (D − U) ÷ 2.</p
